verdict.rationale: The evidence shows TrueLayer can read account, balance and transaction data from a user's bank (Data API) and verify connected accounts. Its only no-integration hosted experience is payment links, which is a payment flow rather than account linking. Nothing documents a drop-in hosted bank-connection widget, server-side session creation, or a token returned for the connected account, so the account-linking capability itself is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a developer, I can let a user connect their bank with a drop-in hosted flow — create a session server-side, open the widget, and get back a token for the connected account — without building institution UI myself
